raw_html: [[Alignment damage (weapon)#Axiomatic|Axiomatic]][[File:Icon tooltip.png|link=|super|10px]]'''[[Alignment damage (weapon)#Axiomatic|Axiomatic]]:''' An axiomatic weapon is lawfully aligned and infused with the power of law. It makes the weapon law-aligned and thus bypasses the corresponding damage reduction. It deals an extra 2 to 12 damage against all of [[chaotic]] alignment.
